To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

cyberbullying is related to depression, anxiety, stress and low self perception and that the relationship between cyber bullying and low self perception is a mediator for the relationship between cyberbulling and depression.

self perception mediates the relationship between cyber bullying and depression symptoms, and locus of control does moderate the relationship between bullying and anxiety and stress symptoms in emerging adults.
cyberbullying has an important effect on the psychological well-being of the emerging adults, especially in terms of depressive symptoms.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role of locus ofcontrol and self perception as mediators in the relationship between the experience of cyberbullying and the development of depression, anxiety andstress symptoms in emerging adults.

the identification of a series of variables that can be used to predict the level of depression, stress and anxiety symptoms in the case of emerging adults who are cyber victims, and the variables can be used to prevent the appearance of depression, anxiety and/or stress symptoms in emerging adults who are victims of cyberbullying.
the identification of mediators and moderators in the relationship between the cyberbullying and mental health of emerging adults.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the self perception construct mediates the relationship between cyber bullying and depression, anxiety or stress symptoms, and locus of control does moderate this relationship.
the self perception mediates the relationship between cyber bullying and depressive symptoms, but the locus of control is not a moderator of that relationship.
cyber victimization causes low self esteem and depression symptoms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

self perception has a mediator role in the relationship between depression, anxiety, stress symptoms and the cyber victimization, and the internal locus of control has a moderator role in the relationship of depression, anxiety and cyberbullying.
the self perception is an important mediator in the relationship that cyber victimization has with the depression, anxiety and the stress symptoms in emerging adults.
the cyber victimization is a risk factor for the emergence of depressive, anxiety and stress disorders.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cyberbullying has a negative impact on emerging adults, causing depressive symptoms.
cyber victimization is a significant risk factor for depression, anxiety and distress symptoms, and the self perception mediates this risk.
cyberbullying is a risk factor that has an effect on the development of depression, anxiety and/or stress symptoms in emerging adults.
